What does "solo built" actually mean?

Every app was conceived, designed, coded, and shipped by one person. Every podcast was scripted, voiced, produced, and automated by one person. That includes game mechanics, App Store submissions, cloud infrastructure, content pipelines, and illustration direction across 491 unique images.

Modern AI tools made this possible, not by replacing thinking, but by compressing the gap between idea and execution. Every creative decision and quality judgment is human. The throughput is not.

Process

How it's built

Strong creative vision, intelligent use of modern tools, and the output shouldn't be possible for one person.

🤖
AI-Assisted Development

App logic, game mechanics, UI systems, and pipelines built using conversational AI as a co-developer. The skill is knowing what to build, how to direct it, and when the output is actually right.

Every line reviewed, tested, and shaped by hand.

🎙
Automated Content Pipelines

All five podcasts researched, scripted, voiced, produced, and published automatically, every day. Building it required designing a system architecture that scales across multiple shows simultaneously.

Zero daily manual effort after initial build.

☁️
Cloud Infrastructure

Apps and pipelines run on modern cloud infrastructure with automated scheduling, deployment, and content delivery. Designed for reliability and scale, managed entirely solo.

Production-grade. Solo-managed.

🎨
AI-Directed Visual Design

App illustrations and art assets generated using image models with carefully engineered prompts. Lore Weave contains 491 unique illustrations, each one directed, reviewed, and tied to a specific story moment.

Direction and curation are the work.

📱
Mobile App Development

Native and cross-platform apps built from concept through App Store submission, including game logic, animations, economy systems, and onboarding flows. Full development cycle handled end to end.

Concept to shipped app. Solo.

📈
Automated Distribution

Social content, short-form video, and podcast distribution across all major platforms are built into the production pipeline, not bolted on after. Consistent daily output across multiple channels.

Built once. Runs forever.

About

One person.
A lot of ambition.

Galapptic started as a question: how much can one person actually build? The answer turned out to be more than expected: apps on the App Store, a network of five daily podcasts, automated production systems, and a library of 491 original illustrated stories. All designed, built, and shipped solo.

Every project pushed into new territory. Mobile development, cloud infrastructure, content pipelines, game design, illustration direction. The skills kept compounding. Each release became a foundation for the next one.

This isn't about doing less. It's about understanding modern tools well enough to punch above your weight class, and caring enough about the craft to make things people actually want to use.

🚀
The Mission

Build things worth using. Make learning feel like play. Ship with intention.

⚡
The Approach

Strong creative vision + modern tooling = output that shouldn't be possible solo.

🌌
Why Galapptic?

Because the universe is vast, and there's always something new worth building in it.

📈
Always Growing

New apps, new shows, new ideas. The portfolio keeps expanding.
